sentence_stem: If you come to my birthday party on Saturday,
correct_completion: we can eat cake and play games together.
full_sentence: If you come to my birthday party on Saturday, we can eat cake and play games together.
acceptable_variants: we will have a lot of fun.
I will give you a present.

options.text: I went to the store yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This is a past fact that does not follow from the condition. After 'if', the result must be about what will happen.
This gives a wrong day and does not complete the result of the condition.

options.text: we can eat cake and play games together.
you are a very tall person.
options.why_wrong: This describes you, but it does not say what happens at the party.

explanation: After 'if', we need a result clause that says what happens when the condition is true. For invitations, use a simple present or future verb to describe the plan.
translation: Si vienes a mi fiesta de cumpleaños el sábado, podemos comer pastel y jugar juegos juntos.
